decision_conditions: Approved Plans:The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents:Drawing No: FC-A-XX-1000-P-00, Title: Location Plan.Drawing No: FC-A-PR-1001-P-00 Rev P01, Title: Proposed Block Plan.Drawing No: FC-A-PR-1002-P-00 Rev P02, Tree Protection Plan.Drawing No: FC-A-EX-1001-P-00 Rev P01, Title: Existing Plan.Drawing No: FC-A-PR-1009-P-00 Rev P01, Title: Proposed Site Levels Plan.Drawing No: FC-A-PR-1010-P-00 Rev P01, Title: Ground Flood Plan.Drawing No: FC-A-PR-1011-P-RF Rev P01, Title: Roof Plan.Drawing No: FC-A-PR-2000-E-X Rev P01, Title: Proposed Elevations. Drawing No: FC-A-PR-3000-S-X Rev P01, Title: Proposed Section.Drawing No: FC-A-PR-4010-P-00 Rev P01, Title: Lighting Plan.Drawing No: FC-A-PR-6001-D-A Rev _01, Title: Detailed Elevations Kiosk A.Drawing No: FC-A-PR-6002-D-B Rev _01, Title: Detailed Elevations Kiosk B.Drawing No: FC-A-PR-6003-D-C Rev _01, Title: Detailed Elevations Kiosk C.Drawing No: FC-A-PR-6004-D-X Rev P01, Title: Signpost and Notice Board Details. Drawing No: 25058-F&C-XX-XX-DR-C-3000 Rev P01, Title: Proposed Civil Layout (foul drainage & potable water).Drawing No: LBEEDG-101 Rev A, Title: Permeable Asphalt detail.Design and Access StatementTree Survey ReportFlood Risk Assessment SUDs ProformaHighway Safety proformaBiodiversity Metric ToolBNG - Pre-Development Plan Baseline MapBiodiversity Gain PlanReason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

Details of New Railings: Prior to their installation, detailed drawings and full material specifications for the new railings shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. The development shall be carried out in full accordance with the approved details.Reason: To ensure a high-quality appearance that preserves and enhances the setting of the non-designated heritage asset, Edmonton Green Station, in accordance with Policies DMD 37 and DMD 44 of the Enfield Development Management Document and London Plan Policy HC1.

Servicing and Waste Management Strategy:Prior to the first occupation/ use of the development hereby approved, a Servicing and Waste Management Strategy shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.The Strategy shall include details of:o	Refuse and recycling storage arrangements (including capacity, location and enclosure design);o	Collection arrangements, including frequency, timing and collection points;o	Arrangements for the movement of bins to and from any presentation points; ando	Servicing arrangements for deliveries, including vehicle types, access routes and hours of operation.The development shall be operated thereafter in full accordance with the approved Servicing and Waste Management Strategy.Reason: To ensure that servicing, refuse and recycling are managed in a safe, efficient and neighbourly manner, in accordance with London Plan Policies T7 and SI7 and Policies DMD 45, DMD 47, DMD 48 and DMD 57 of the Enfield Development Management Document.

Seating Installation Method Statement:Prior to installation of the proposed seating around the young cherry trees, a detailed specification and method statement for the design and installation of the seating shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The method statement shall demonstrate how works will be undertaken without causing harm to the trees, including their Root Protection Areas (RPAs).The seating shall thereafter be installed strictly in accordance with the approved details.Reason: To ensure the protection and long-term health of the young cherry trees and to preserve the amenity and landscape quality of the site, in accordance with London Plan Policy G7, Core Strategy Policy 36, and Policies DMD 80 and DMD 81 of the Enfield Development Management Document (2014).

Time limit for Full Permission:The development hereby permitted shall be begun not later than 3 years from the date of this permission.Reason: To comply with the requirements of Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990

Temporary Permission:This permission shall be for a limited period only, expiring five years from the date of the first use and occupation of the approved buildings. At the expiry of this five year period the land shall be restored to its former use and state with all resultant debris removed. Reason: To enable the Council to consider the matter at the end of the period having regard to the circumstances existing at the time, safeguarding the character and appearance of site and surrounding area and amenity of residents.

External Materials: The external materials to be used in the construction of the development hereby permitted shall accord with the specification stated in the Design and Access Statement and Application form submitted with the application unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Reason: To ensure the development accords with the submitted details and achieves a high-quality appearance, in the interests of visual amenity and in accordance with Policies DMD 37 and DMD 44 of the Enfield Development Management Document and Policy D3 of the London Plan.
description: Installation of a meanwhile marketplace comprising three small trading units (kiosks) with associated landscaping, and public realm enhancements.

open_spaces_details.description: 101.5 sq.m of the existing open space will be transformed into a meanwhile marketplace hosting 3 small kiosks which will support local businesses and activate the underused green space which is currently suffers from antisocial behaviour.  These are temporary works which lead on to long term plans to improve the blue and green infrastructure of the space by deculverting Salmons Brook, increasing biodiversity to encourage a riparian habitat and aiding flood alleviation.
